name: pctext-eu
note: The European release's save messages say PC, not Xbox, in its game_language (1 English, 3 German, 4 French, 5 Spanish, 6 Italian: --set game_language=5 --release eu): Continue with no save on the hard disk shows its no-data message (src/common/pc_text.cpp, data\global2e?.dar). Through 1.10.1 they named the Xbox in all five.

steps.note: the load screen: no game data present on the PC, in the game's language
expect: found(runlog, r'pc text: 9 of the save messages say .{1,20}global2e' + {1: 'e', 3: 'g', 4: 'f', 5: 'p', 6: 'i'}[settings.game_language] + r'\.dar')
